stories.title: Democrats take control of House and Senate in midterm elections
stories.line: Democrats won control of the House and Senate in the midterms, giving them power to check Trump's agenda, including on Iran and Ukraine.

Spanish police open homicide probe after goalkeeper collision kills footballer
stories.line: A goalkeeper's collision in a Spanish match left a footballer dead, and police are now investigating it as a homicide.

stories.title: Iran claims U.S. midterm results signal American rejection of the war
stories.line: Iran's officials are citing the U.S. midterm results, which handed Democrats Congress, as a rejection of American involvement in the war.

stories.title: Talarico defeats Paxton in Texas Senate race, ending decades of GOP dominance
stories.line: Democrat James Talarico beat Ken Paxton for Texas's Senate seat, the first Democratic Senate win there in decades, after Musk spent $47M backing Paxton.

stories.title: Democrats take control of Congress in midterm sweep
stories.line: Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress in the 2026 midterms, a result many voters read as a rebuke of Trump.

stories.title: Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Senate seat, becoming first Muslim US senator
stories.line: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed won Michigan's Senate race, making him the first Muslim senator in US history.

stories.title: After midterm losses, Trump likely to turn his attention to foreign policy
stories.line: Democrats' midterm wins curb Trump's domestic power, so he may shift focus to foreign policy, with Europe bracing for pressure.
